verdict.rationale: Bulk public-data publishing is a fair axis for a state revenue agency, but the evidence never documents a downloadable dataset, registry extract, or statistics file. It shows only interactive lookups ("Look up a business", "Find a sales and use tax rate") and a published list of B&O tax rates, with no stated download format. Probes found no machine-readable surfaces (llms.txt, markdown docs, OpenAPI all 404).
